subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Obvious
solution: The correct answer is **"Cryptic."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Obvious"** means easily noticeable or understood. (जो आसानी से दिखाई दे या समझ में आए; स्‍पष्‍ट) • **Example**: *For **obvious**__ reasons, I’d prefer not to give my name.* • So, its antonym will be a word that means difficult to understand or obscure. • The word **"cryptic"** means having a meaning that is mysterious or obscure. (गुप्‍त अर्थ वाला; रहस्‍यमय) __ • **Example**: I* got a **cryptic**__ text message from Sam.* • Hence it is the most appropriate antonym for **obvious**. • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Plain** - simple or straightforward. (देखने, सुनने, समझने में आसान; स्‍पष्‍ट) • **Straight** - direct or not curved. (जिसमें न मोड़ हों न घुमाव; सीधा) • **Clear **- easy to perceive, understand, or interpret. (देखने, सुनने या समझने में स्‍पष्‍ट, साफ़) 188:Te02, The correct answer is **"considered."**
